title: Eversource
description: Ever wanted to have your very own EverSource chicken, like in Minecraft StoryMode? Well, now you can. It's been updated to work with all the new mobs added in 1.21.9...
body:
Hi everyone!

Ever wanted to have your very own EverSource chicken, like in Minecraft StoryMode? Well, now you can. It's been updated to work with all the new mobs added in 1.21.9... You can obtain 1 by either a random hatch from a chicken egg (legit), and/or you can get a free one when you 1st load the datapack. You can have multiple EverSource chickens at once, to massively produce the Spawn Eggs!
